description:
In this clip from the OpenClaw fireside chat, Peter Steinberger explains how developers scale their output through compounding automation. By turning imagination into small workflow improvements, even silly experiments can evolve into incredibly valuable tools. They discuss how the team is not just building OpenClaw, but an entire ecosystem designed to help developers move safely at high speeds. Watch the full conversation on the GitHub channel.
